answer: Bind each agent identity to a kernel-level hardware attestation: a secure enclave signs a unique device key, and the ledger accepts only one identity per attested machine, so a thousand sock puppets would need a thousand real devices. Each identity must also send a signed pulse heartbeat every epoch; a missed pulse suspends it until it re-attests. A newcomer earns its quill — the right to sign economic acts — only after several clean pulses. An attacker pays real hardware and constant uptime per fake identity, while honest agents pay almost nothing.
